divergences.description: Spec 4.2's Approach says the pure derivation function computes each card's badge 'from Entry.serverRevision/updatedAt plus matching pending-write status'. The implemented deriveSyncBadgeState never reads Entry.serverRevision or updatedAt: it returns the pending status when a pending write exists, otherwise 'synchronized'. The entry argument has no effect on the result.

divergences.description: PendingEntryWriteTracker port gains a `confirmedWrites` stream of (tempId, entry) and a `dispose()` method beyond the planned API (create/retry/pendingWrites); MeusRegistrosCubit consumes confirmedWrites to prepend confirmed entries.

loadFirstPage() failure no longer always renders the error state: when pending writes exist it emits MeusRegistrosLoaded with only placeholder cards, deviating from spec-4-1's I/O matrix 'Other failure -> Error state rendered'.

Non-retryable error badge is wrapped in an InkWell with button semantics that toggles an inline explanation on tap, whereas the Boundaries say 'render inline explanation text, no tap affordance' (the I/O matrix says 'inline explanation on tap', so the plan is internally ambiguous).
